title.rendered: Danya Bashir from Arqaam discusses Investing in MENA at Mobility Live Middle East & Saudi

content.rendered:
Danya Bashir from Arqaam discusses Investing in #MENA at Mobility Live Middle East & Saudi
The shared mobility market was valued at US$127.45 billion in 2021, projected to grow at a CAGR of 12.05% from 2022 to 2031, reaching US$397.61 billion by 2031.

Electric and autonomous vehicles are reshaping this sector, offering cost efficiencies and sustainability advantages.
